source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The proceedings define one auxiliary childless selector S, define graph edges through SCM parent/exogenous sharing, give Eq. 23 and Algorithm 1, prove soundness, and explicitly conjecture completeness.

The paper studies conditional generalized identification from observational/interventional Q[S] inputs, imposes positivity, and proves a sound-and-complete c-gID algorithm; it is adjacent rather than a selected-subpopulation inverse-lift result.

The paper gives a graphical identification algorithm for data fusion with arbitrary unobserved confounding and systematic selection into multiple experimental regimes, requiring an explicit scope comparison.

The preprint gives necessary-and-sufficient ATE identifiability conditions under selection bias using probability classes; this is distinct from graphwise latent S-ID completeness over arbitrary ADMGs.
